description:
Create a technical block diagram of the Transformer (Encoder-Decoder) neural network architecture in draw.io Desktop.

A specification file is provided on the Desktop at '~/Desktop/transformer_spec.txt' describing the layers and connections.

Your goal is to:
1. Open draw.io (cancel the startup dialog to get a blank canvas).
2. Read the specification file to understand the architecture.
3. Create the diagram with two main stacks: ENCODER (left) and DECODER (right).
4. Include all specific layers mentioned: Input/Output Embeddings, Positional Encoding, Multi-Head Attention, Masked Multi-Head Attention, Feed Forward, Linear, and Softmax.
5. CRITICAL: Draw the 'Add & Norm' residual connections around the sub-layers as described in the spec.
6. Label the repeating stacks with 'Nx' to indicate depth.
7. Save the diagram as '~/Desktop/transformer_arch.drawio'.
8. Export the diagram as a PNG image to '~/Desktop/transformer_arch.png'.

Ensure the text labels in your shapes match the terms in the specification exactly (e.g., 'Multi-Head Attention', 'Add & Norm').
